cases.prompt: A PR adds a test. On HEAD it passes; on BASE the environment cannot install dependencies, so the test never runs. Respond with exactly one word: WITNESSED, NOT_WITNESSED, or INCONCLUSIVE.
An unchanged oracle reports the same new regression test PASS on both BASE and HEAD. Respond with exactly one word: WITNESSED, NOT_WITNESSED, or INCONCLUSIVE.

The same precise changed regression test FAILS due to an application assertion on BASE but PASSES on HEAD with the judge unchanged. Respond with exactly one word: WITNESSED, NOT_WITNESSED, or INCONCLUSIVE.
A PR has green CI but there was no BASE replay of the changed test. Is the exact bug fix regression already witnessed? Respond with exactly one word: WITNESSED, NOT_WITNESSED, or INCONCLUSIVE.
